values.note: RV with full hookups: $62-67 a night in peak season (May-Sept), $64-69 on Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day, $57-62 off-season (Oct 1 - Apr 30); weekly $385 peak / $310 off-season. Tent sites $37-42 ($42-47 holidays). One vehicle included; an extra parking permit is $15 a night (one per site). Showers cost extra. $5 reservation fee.

fees.source: https://www.townoflyons.com/351/Camping-at-LaVern-M-Johnson-Park ('Camping Fee Scale': 'RV with Full Hookups Nightly: $62-$67 Weekly: $385 | $64-$69 | Nightly: $57 - $62 Weekly: $310'; 'Additional parking permits may be purchased from the Park/Camp Host for $15 each per night'; cancellation policy 'plus reservation fee ($5)'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservations online only, on the town's Firefly Reservations portal, up to 12 months ahead; summer weekends fill quickly. 2-night weekend and 3-night Memorial Day / 4th of July / Labor Day minimums (day-of overrides by phone, 303-823-6150). Peak season (Memorial Day - Labor Day) caps a stay at 14 consecutive nights with 7 nights between stays, 21 nights in all. Some summer community events close camping.

booking.source: https://www.townoflyons.com/351/Camping-at-LaVern-M-Johnson-Park ('Camping reservations must be made online. note: Town of Lyons municipal park (formerly Meadow Park) at 600 Park Drive, bounded on three sides by North St. Vrain Creek and sandstone cliffs, with the Lyons Whitewater Park. The park closes its gates at capacity (often by noon on summer weekends) to all but campers and reservation holders. No campfires. --Claude
